column1: # markers.tsv -- Kernel detection markers (PLAN section 5). Tab separated, '#' lines ignored.
# columns: tier | group | scope | ERE | exclude-ERE (optional) | needles
#   tier 1  one hit is enough.  tier 2  needs hits from two different groups.
#   scope   all = any text file; cfg = only manifests/CI/config files (.github/workflows, Dockerfile*, Makefile,
#   ERE     POSIX ERE, no intervals (older mawk lacks them), no \s/\w.
#   exclude lines matching it are not a hit for this marker.
#   needles ';'-separated literal substrings; every line the ERE matches contains one of them. The repo-wide scan
#           (scope=all) greps for the needles with -F (30x faster than the ERE union on a 28k-file tree) and the
#           ERE then confirms each candidate line. When you change an ERE, keep its needles in sync.
